assessments.reasoning: The inspected title or publisher description identifies the enrolled IEEE Std 1076-1987 VHDL Language Reference Manual, GovInfo copy authority. Retained native HTTP 200 bytes match SHA-256 044a76a37d0d4e2a0ae7b807a5dd7654206b9bb4e353b65cfa1dee832c4debbd. Inspected the exact text described by §9.2 Process Statement, sensitivity-list paragraph and implicit-wait example, printed p. 9-3 (PDF p. 123). Under IEEE 1076-1987, a process statement with a sensitivity list has an implicit final wait on that list, and the process statement cannot contain an explicit wait statement. The process has an explicit sensitivity list following the reserved word process. This covers the process statement. Procedure-parent constraints and later process syntax require separate treatment. The source treats an explicitly listed process separately from a process with no list and gives a further rule concerning procedures parented by the process. The claim is scoped to the listed process itself.
